description:
Share one issue snapshot across graph and base issue projections for each tracker version, while retaining live derived-document visibility.

## Background

The list and graph handlers each load all issues today. The list also calls `DocumentOps::with_reported_documents`, which discovers artifact paths outside the watched data directory; caching that complete response would hide artifact changes.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Concurrent list and graph requests share one captured issue snapshot and cached base projections per version; failed attempts remain retryable and stale completion cannot replace a newer generation.
- [hard] REQ-02: The list applies fresh derived-document discovery over captured issue records without another issue listing, so adding, deleting or renaming an artifact after cache warm updates its reported documents at the same tracker version.
- [hard] REQ-03: Configuration invalidation rebuilds projections with current declarations. Deterministic tests cover concurrent admission, version crossings, failure/retry and live artifact changes; tracker versions remain invalidation hints, not transaction revisions.

- [hard] REQ-04: Apply @/charter/D-25 through the canonical shared read path: after bounded optimistic retries, return a typed retryable conflict without acquiring a repository writer/session lock or performing implicit recovery. Admit the entire selected+primary issue capture, preserving membership and tombstones; in-memory read admission must not wait for writer-held state.
- [hard] REQ-05: Expose RETRYABLE_CONFLICT with CLI exit 12 and HTTP 503 through the shared classifier; keep stable data errors distinct. Align charter projections and adopter documentation with D-25. Explicit recovery and mutation recovery retain D-17 semantics.

## Notes

Use the shared executor helper and existing lock-free repository read behavior; do not hold a writer lock across async work.
title: Share version-scoped issue capture and projections
